title: The Calendar Stone of Sithis
summary: Bright-Throat carvers and Dead-Water hunters stand on the brink of blood-feud over a missing Sithis Calendar Stone needed to realign the Grand Calendar Xanmeer above Soulrest Sound.

hook.rumour: The fourth obsidian Calendar Stone was pried from its plinth above Soulrest Sound, and Dead-Water war-canoes are already painted for a feud with the Bright-Throat stilt-villages.
hook.notice: SOULREST SOUND & BRIGHT-THROAT ELDERS: Envoys needed to trace the missing Sithis Calendar Stone and restore the Grand Calendar Xanmeer.

npcs.name: Warden of Murkmire
npcs.greet: The fourth obsidian Calendar Stone was pried from its plinth above Soulrest Sound, and Dead-Water war-canoes are already painted for a feud with the Bright-Throat stilt-villages.
talk: The trouble across Murkmire began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Murkmire.
If you mean to help the Bright-Throat & Dead-Water Tribes, start by checking the trail between Murkmire and Sweet Wallow Hist Grove.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Murkmire
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Sweet Wallow Hist Grove is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Sweet Wallow Hist Grove toward Tsezuku before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Murkmire so Barge-Mother Seeth-Ka can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Tsezuku
npcs.greet: You made good time from Sweet Wallow Hist Grove. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Red Tail Spring.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Red Tail Spring with a picked guard.
Once Red Tail Spring is cleared, return to Murkmire to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Murkmire
npcs.greet: Barge-Mother Seeth-Ka awaits word on whether the crisis in Murkmire has been contained.
talk: The elders of Murkmire have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Murkmire owes you a debt for standing between Murkmire and ruin.
